name: independent-install-checks
reviewer: Independent reviewer (Claude Opus 5 CLI documentation review seat)

steps.action: Sign in through the intended origin and create a fictional Contract
steps.actual: Signed in at the installed origin as the first Administrator and created Contract 1 using the Contract type "undefined".

steps.action: Upload a small supported Document, download it again, and compare bytes
steps.actual: Uploaded a 1-page PDF to the Contract and downloaded it again; the returned bytes hash to the uploaded SHA-256 eab9971a640e647d… (full value retained privately).
The worker and document engine took the new Version to processing state "ready" and the extracted text carries the uploaded words.

steps.action: Confirm the worker processes new work after a restart
steps.actual: Restarted the worker container with docker compose restart worker, then uploaded a second PDF: it reached "ready" and its download matched the uploaded bytes. Services before the restart: app Up 3 minutes (healthy); doc-engine Up 3 minutes (healthy); postgres Up 3 minutes (healthy); worker Up 3 minutes.
